title: Policy-gated apply & rollback for batching/caching cost recommendations (RBAC + audit)
creator: Marcus Chen
description: Implement a policy-first execution path for automatically applying and rolling back batching and KV-cache recommendations produced by the Cost Optimization service. The feature must enforce least-privilege via RBAC, record immutable audit trails for every suggested change and operator action, and provide an auditable change-management workflow (approval steps, scheduled windows, emergency overrides). The goal is to enable safe, auditable automation so Platform/Customer operators can reduce per-token cost while meeting compliance and SLO constraints.
acceptance_criteria: All automated apply actions are gated by RBAC role checks; only users with the 'cost-automation:apply' role may trigger an immediate apply.
Every apply or rollback event is recorded in the audit log with actor, timestamp, diff of config, pre/post runtime snapshot, and a unique trace id.
Automated recommendations may be configured to 'preview-only' for environments with compliance restrictions; preview must produce the exact diff that would be applied.
Change requests created by the system are surfaced in the Console change-management queue and include policy metadata (risk score, affected models/pools, expected cost delta).
Support scheduled rollout windows and canary fractioning for batching changes, with automatic safety rollback triggers on latency regressions or error spikes.
Security reviewers can revoke a recommendation and mark it as forbidden for a tenant; forbidden recommendations cannot be re-applied without a manual override recorded in the audit log.
Unit and integration test coverage for RBAC enforcement, audit payload structure, and rollback path provided in CI; no regressions allowed in logging schema.
Documentation updated: Console runbook for approving/rejecting recommendations and API reference for the audit event schema.
Telemetry includes cost-savings estimate and post-apply realized delta, surfaced for 30 days and attached to the change record.
tasks: Design RBAC model and new roles: cost-automation:preview, cost-automation:request, cost-automation:apply, cost-automation:override.
Define audit event schema (fields, retention, immutability guarantees) and store in existing auditable storage path (S3 + WORM metadata).
Add change-request object (immutable id, proposer, approvers, status, diffs, expected deltas) to Console change-management UI and API.
Implement server-side policy engine checks in the autosuggest pipeline before permitting apply; integrate with IAM service.
Wire canary rollout hooks: fraction parameter, latency/error monitors, auto-rollback triggers using existing tracing and SLO guardrails.
Add preview endpoint that returns full runtime diff and cost simulation without mutating runtime configs.
Integration tests: RBAC positive/negative cases, audit record verification, canary rollback flow under induced latency regressions.
Run security review and threat model for override paths; add guardrail that override events require two approvers and must be recorded with justification.
Create migration for existing saved recommendations to include risk score and policy metadata.
Update ops runbooks and postmortem checklist to include automation-related incidents and audit lookup steps.
